content_html:
watched #ManaOoriRamayanam : Different story and concept with undercover emotions!!! PrakashRaj n Priyamani nailed it with performance (which is expected) but a serious matured performance by Pruthvi (30 yrs industry)…….on though its hardly 2 hrs movie, normal audience feel like the movie is running for ages due to its single point and sublime emotions without heavy dialogues, Music by Illeyaraja is good and fits in the bill.

Though the movie is clean U many may not get connected due to its matured/bold concept. Hatsoff to PrakashRaj for molding such a matured storyline to a clean U movie.

One Time Watch for all those movie lovers who encourage different concept movies.
